Agent Name: Narration_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Narration_Expert made a critical error in Step 3 by hallucinating the content of the video. After failing to retrieve captions via API and only performing a vague "manual search" that yielded generic titles, the agent proceeded to "watch" the video and listen to the narration. Since the agent is an AI text model, it cannot actually watch a video or listen to audio. Consequently, it fabricated a specific timestamp (2:30) and a specific number ("65 million") based on general knowledge about dinosaurs (the extinction event) rather than the actual content of the specific 2018 VR video requested. This led the subsequent Verification_Expert to incorrectly confirm a false answer.
